crm_notes: Account: product-led mid-market CX vendor building AI-first support agent and search layer.
Started on Hosted API (fast onboarding) -> POC -> moving toward Dedicated for predictable latency & data isolation.
VP Product quote: 'We need predictable tail latency during Monday morning spikes — can't have surprises.'
Short-term ask: dedicated reservation for peak windows w/ burst on demand; mid-term: possibility to shift to Private/VPC in 12-18 months.
Technical constraints: customer on AWS us-east-1, must route through their VPC peering, SAML SSO with Okta, KMS for key wrap.
Finance: wants 12-month committed spend option but willing to start with 6-month ramp and evaluate conversion to annual after Q3 metrics.
Notes from SE: prompt set includes long transcripts (avg 1200 tokens) -> pay attention to KV cache and quantization recommendations.
Customer cares about cost per-1000 messages and per-embedding unit; asked for sample TCO sheet comparing hosted vs dedicated at 200k messages/mo.
Corner-case: internal legal flagged portability clause + audit log retention — must have 7 years of audit logs available for compliance team review.
Tone: pragmatic; heavy focus on SLAs and ops playbooks. Not trying to build infra; will pay for predictability if economics align.
poc_details: POC scope: evaluate latency SLOs, throughput (>= 120 qps sustained), and cost per 1M tokens across hosted vs dedicated.
Success criteria: p95 latency < 250ms for chat flows, embeddings throughput >= 300/sec, <15% variance in token cost month-to-month.
Data supplied: 25k sample conversations, schema for ticket metadata, traffic pattern (diurnal with Monday morning spikes).
Milestones: ingest data -> baseline on hosted API (done) -> dedicated staging run (done) -> pricing & SLA negotiation (in progress).
pricing_negotiation_summary: Customer preference: commit-to-dedicated with an initial 6-month ramp (50% of target commit for months 1-2, 75% months 3-4, 100% months 5-6).
Requested burst: 2.5x capacity for short windows (up to 4 hours/day) with capped burst spend; wants automatic fallback to hosted during major incidents.
Discount asks: 20-30% off list for 12-month commit vs paygo; seeking blended rate for embeddings and chat tokens. Finance pushing for volume tiers.
Overage model desired: clear per-GPU-hour overage rate + per-token cap; customer requests example invoices for 3 traffic scenarios.
Ramp & conversion: prefer ability to convert 6-month ramp into annual reserved contract without penalty if metrics hit targets; legal wants a 30-day exit clause for non-performance.
Redwood proposal v2: 6-month ramp, 40% committed baseline (GPU-hours), burst allowed up to 2x with overage billed at X per GPU-hour and token overage at $0.0008/token — under review by Lodestar.
Key negotiation points still open: final overage $/GPU-hour, SLA credits for p95 breaches, definition of 'burst window', data residency addendum.
